project_title: Straddle ATR Band — Re-Centering Roller Automated Options Trading Terminal
design_principles: High Data Density: Compact 1px bordered grid panels, zero unnecessary whitespace, dense tabular data layout.
Unmistakable Mode Hierarchy: LIVE trading mode triggers high-visibility hazardous amber/red outline + pulse status header, PAPER is crisp cyan/blue, BACKTEST is cool slate/purple.
Institutional Ergonomics: Monospaced numeric alignment (font-mono tabular-nums), sharp contrast, zero gradients, zero rounded consumer-fintech cards.

Financial Color Discipline: Strictly reserve Crimson Red (#EF4444) for loss/short/bearish/exit/emergency and Emerald Green (#10B981) for profit/long/bullish/entry. Use Amber (#F59E0B) for execution warnings and attention states.
Strict 1px Structural Grid: Border-collapse style technical paneling with #1E293B / #262626 strokes and high readability contrast.

typography.heading_font: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, Menlo, monospace
typography.font_pairing_strategy: Monospace for all financial metrics, ticker quotes, order sizes, strike prices, and log data. Clean sans-serif for secondary labels.

key_components.name: TopHeaderBar
key_components.description: Displays App Brand 'QUANT-ROLLER PRO v2.4', Upstox Connection Status (API Ping / Token Valid), Live Data WebSockets indicator, Live Market Clock (IST), Trading Mode Toggle (BACKTEST | PAPER | LIVE), Algo Status Pill, and Quick Lock/Emergency trigger.

key_components.name: LeftNavigationArea
key_components.description: Tab menu switching between Terminal, Strategy Config, Backtest Engine, Positions Blotter, Order Book, Trade History, System Logs, and Upstox Settings + Algo Controller Action Group (START ALGO, STOP ALGO, EMERGENCY SQUARE-OFF).

key_components.name: MainMarketStrategyChart
key_components.description: Interactive quantitative candlestick chart rendering NIFTY/BANKNIFTY spot price, dynamic Straddle Center Line, Upper ATR Band, Lower ATR Band, Initial Entry Marker, Roll Up/Down Markers, and Exit Markers with interval switches (1m, 3m, 5m, 15m) and indicator toggles.

key_components.name: RightStrategyStatusPanel
key_components.description: Detailed realtime breakdown: Strategy State Badge (WAITING...ACTIVE_BASKET...ROLL_UP), Current Spot vs Center Strike, ATR Distance to Upper/Lower boundaries, Total Basket P&L (MTM), Max Profit / Max Loss metrics, Account Balance & Margin Utilized from Upstox API.

key_components.name: FourLegBasketPanel
key_components.description: Dedicated 4-leg visual card/table displaying leg status: Short CE, Short PE, Long CE Hedge, Long PE Hedge with per-leg strike, expiry, lot count, avg execution price, LTP, leg MTM, and Upstox order ID.

key_components.name: BottomExecutionTerminal
key_components.description: Tabbed Blotter System (ORDERS, POSITIONS, TRADES, EVENTS, ERRORS) featuring high-density compact tables, filter inputs, live execution status indicators, and CSV export buttons.

key_components.name: LiveTradingConfirmationModal
key_components.description: High-risk confirmation dialog triggered when switching to LIVE mode or executing Emergency Square-off, requiring double acknowledgement and Upstox PIN/TOTP validation warning.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure dark quantitative workstation aesthetic. DO NOT use light mode or consumer colorful cards.
Ensure all numbers are monospaced with tabular numerals (font-mono tabular-nums) to prevent jumping when ticks arrive.
Implement real-time market data simulation or Upstox tick feed mock if backend API disconnects, keeping the UI alive.
Borders must be 1px solid (#243046 or slate-800). Radii must be minimal (rounded-sm or rounded-none) for a technical terminal feel.
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, metric, and status badge includes its exact data-testid as specified.
Add visual flash effects on price updates (e.g. subtle green/red text highlight flash on price ticks).
Keep layout rigid and fixed to 100vh desktop viewports without horizontal page scrollbars.
